headline: Sunway Construction Wins $655 Million Data Center Contracts in Malaysia
summary: Sunway Construction Group secured two contracts totaling 2.66 billion ringgit ($655.4 million) to build data center projects in Malaysia's Johor and Selangor states.
why: Rapid expansion in artificial intelligence and cloud computing infrastructure drives large-scale construction contracts for engineering firms.

impacts.name: Sunway Construction Group Bhd
impacts.why: Securing $655 million in new contracts significantly boosts the firm's order book.
